```{=html}
    document.getElementById('rb-position-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
  }
  function fillSlotOptions(){
    const opts = slots.map((s,i)=>`<option value="${i}">${s.label}</option>`).join('');
    slotValueSel.innerHTML = opts; slotEndSel.innerHTML = opts;
  }
  function updateSlotVisibility(mode){
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-value-wrap').style.display = mode==='any' ? 'none' : 'flex';
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-end-wrap').style.display = mode==='range' ? 'flex' : 'none';
    document.getElementById('rb-slot-value-wrap').querySelector('label').textContent = mode==='range' ? 'From' : 'At';
  }
  fillSlotOptions();

  function buildRuleFromForm(){
    const personMode = personModeSel.value, positionMode = positionModeSel.value, slotMode = slotModeSel.value;
    const person = personMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:personMode, value:personValueSel.value};
    const position = positionMode==='any' ? {mode:'any'} : {mode:positionMode, value:positionValueSel.value};
    let slot;
    if(slotMode==='any') slot = {mode:'any'};
    else if(slotMode==='id') slot = {mode:'id', value:Number(slotValueSel.value)};
    else {
      let start = Number(slotValueSel.value), end = Number(slotEndSel.value);
      if(end<start){ const t=start; start=end; end=t; }
      slot = {mode:'range', start, end};
    }
    const tags = document.getElementById('rb-tags').value.split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    return {
      strength: document.getElementById('rb-strength').value,
      effect: document.getElementById('rb-effect').value,
      active: document.getElementById('rb-active').checked,
      person, position, slot, tags
    };
  }
  function updatePreview(){
    document.getElementById('rb-preview').textContent = ruleLabel(buildRuleFromForm());
  }

  personModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillPersonValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  positionModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ fillPositionValueOptions(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  slotModeSel.addEventListener('change', (e)=>{ updateSlotVisibility(e.target.value); updatePreview(); });
  ['rb-strength','rb-effect','rb-person-value','rb-position-value','rb-slot-value','rb-slot-end','rb-tags','rb-active'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.addEventListener('change', updatePreview);
    el.addEventListener('input', updatePreview);
  });

  if(editing){
    document.getElementById('rb-strength').value = editing.strength;
    document.getElementById('rb-effect').value = editing.effect;
    document.getElementById('rb-active').checked = editing.active;
    personModeSel.value = editing.person.mode;
    fillPersonValueOptions(editing.person.mode);
    if(editing.person.mode!=='any') personValueSel.value = editing.person.value;
    positionModeSel.value = editing.position.mode;
    fillPositionValueOptions(editing.position.mode);
    if(editing.position.mode!=='any') positionValueSel.value = editing.position.value;
    slotModeSel.value = editing.slot.mode;
    updateSlotVisibility(editing.slot.mode);
    if(editing.slot.mode==='id') slotValueSel.value = editing.slot.value;
    if(editing.slot.mode==='range'){ slotValueSel.value = editing.slot.start; slotEndSel.value = editing.slot.end; }
    document.getElementById('rb-tags').value = (editing.tags||[]).join(', ');
  } else {
    fillPersonValueOptions('any');
    fillPositionValueOptions('any');
    updateSlotVisibility('any');
  }
  updatePreview();

  document.getElementById('rb-submit').addEventListener('click', ()=>{
    const draft = buildRuleFromForm();
    if(draft.person.mode!=='any' && !draft.person.value){ alert('Choose a specific person or tag.'); return; }
    if(draft.position.mode!=='any' && !draft.position.value){ alert('Choose a specific position or tag.'); return; }
    if(editing) Object.assign(editing, draft);
    else state.rules.push({ id:genId('rule'), ...draft });
    editingRuleId = null;
    renderRulesTab(); renderAll();
  });
  const cancelBtn = document.getElementById('rb-cancel');
  if(cancelBtn) cancelBtn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = null; renderRulesTab(); });

  const tbody = document.getElementById('rules-tbody');
  state.rules.forEach(r=>{
    const tr = document.createElement('tr');
    tr.innerHTML = `<td>${escapeHtml(ruleLabel(r))}</td><td>${r.strength}</td><td>${r.active?'yes':'no'}</td>
      <td style="white-space:nowrap;"><button class="db-icon-btn" data-edit-rule="${r.id}">✎</button> <button class="db-icon-btn" data-del-rule="${r.id}">🗑</button></td>`;
    tbody.appendChild(tr);
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-edit-rule]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = btn.dataset.editRule; renderRulesTab(); });
  });
  tbody.querySelectorAll('[data-del-rule]').forEach(btn=>{
    btn.addEventListener('click', ()=>{
      if(!confirm('Delete this rule?')) return;
      state.rules = state.rules.filter(r=>r.id!==btn.dataset.delRule);
      if(editingRuleId===btn.dataset.delRule) editingRuleId = null;
      renderRulesTab(); renderAll();
    });
  });
}

/* ================================================================
   EXCEL SAVE / LOAD
   ================================================================ */
function exportToExcel(){
  if(typeof XLSX==='undefined'){ alert('The spreadsheet library has not finished loading yet — try again in a moment.'); return; }
  const wb = XLSX.utils.book_new();
  const slots = getSlots();

  const header = ['Person', ...slots.map(s=>s.label)];
  const rows = state.people.map(p=>{
    const row = [p.name];
    for(const s of slots){
      const a = state.assignments.find(a=>a.personId===p.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(s.index));
      row.push(a ? positionName(a.positionId) : '');
    }
    return row;
  });
  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([header, ...rows]), 'Schedule');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.people.map(p=>(
    { id:p.id, name:p.name, tags:p.tags.join(',') }
  ))), 'People');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.positions.map(p=>(
    { id:p.id, name:p.name, durationMinutes:p.durationMinutes, singlePerson:p.singlePerson, color:p.color, tags:p.tags.join(',') }
  ))), 'Positions');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.tags.map(t=>(
    { id:t.id, name:t.name, category:t.category, highlightColor:t.highlightColor, textColor:t.textColor }
  ))), 'Tags');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.json_to_sheet(state.rules.map(r=>({
    id:r.id, strength:r.strength, active:r.active, effect:r.effect,
    personMode:r.person.mode, personValue:r.person.value||'',
    positionMode:r.position.mode, positionValue:r.position.value||'',
    slotMode:r.slot.mode,
    slotValue: r.slot.mode==='range' ? `${r.slot.start}-${r.slot.end}` : (r.slot.value!==undefined ? r.slot.value : ''),
    tags:(r.tags||[]).join(','), note: ruleLabel(r)
  }))), 'Rules');

  XLSX.utils.book_append_sheet(wb, XLSX.utils.aoa_to_sheet([
    ['startMinutes','endMinutes'], [state.settings.startMinutes, state.settings.endMinutes]
  ]), 'Settings');

  XLSX.writeFile(wb, `duty-board-${new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)}.xlsx`);
  showToast('Schedule saved.');
}

async function importFromExcel(file){
  if(typeof XLSX==='undefined') throw new Error('spreadsheet library not loaded yet');
  const buf = await file.arrayBuffer();
  const wb = XLSX.read(buf, { type:'array' });

  if(wb.Sheets['Settings']){
    const s = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Settings'], { header:1 });
    if(s[1] && s[1].length>=2){ state.settings.startMinutes = Number(s[1][0]); state.settings.endMinutes = Number(s[1][1]); }
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['Tags']){
    state.tags = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Tags']).map(r=>({
      id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name), category:r.category==='position'?'position':'person',
      highlightColor:r.highlightColor || '#eef1f5', textColor:r.textColor || '#647186'
    }));
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['People']){
    state.people = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['People']).map(r=>({
      id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name),
      tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    }));
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['Positions']){
    state.positions = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Positions']).map(r=>({
      id:String(r.id), name:String(r.name), durationMinutes:Number(r.durationMinutes)||15,
      singlePerson: r.singlePerson===true || r.singlePerson==='TRUE' || r.singlePerson==='true',
      color:r.color || '#3b6fd6',
      tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
    }));
  }
  if(wb.Sheets['Rules']){
    state.rules = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Rules']).map(r=>{
      let slot;
      if(r.slotMode==='range'){ const [a,b]=String(r.slotValue).split('-').map(Number); slot={mode:'range', start:a, end:b}; }
      else if(r.slotMode==='id'){ slot = {mode:'id', value:Number(r.slotValue)}; }
      else slot = {mode:'any'};
      return {
        id:String(r.id), strength:r.strength==='preferred'?'preferred':'required',
        active: r.active===true || r.active==='TRUE' || r.active==='true',
        effect:r.effect==='require'?'require':'forbid',
        person:{ mode:r.personMode||'any', value:r.personValue||null },
        position:{ mode:r.positionMode||'any', value:r.positionValue||null },
        slot,
        tags:String(r.tags||'').split(',').map(s=>s.trim()).filter(Boolean)
      };
    });
  }

  state.assignments = [];
  if(wb.Sheets['Schedule']){
    const rows = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_json(wb.Sheets['Schedule'], { header:1 });
    for(let r=1; r<rows.length; r++){
      const row = rows[r];
      if(!row || !row.length) continue;
      const person = state.people.find(p=>p.name===row[0]);
      if(!person) continue;
      for(let col=1; col<row.length; col++){
        const posName = row[col];
        if(!posName) continue;
        const pos = state.positions.find(p=>p.name===posName);
        if(!pos) continue;
        const startSlot = col-1;
        const alreadyCovered = state.assignments.some(a=>a.personId===person.id && assignmentOccupiesSlots(a).includes(startSlot));
        if(alreadyCovered) continue;
        state.assignments.push({ id:genId('asg'), personId:person.id, positionId:pos.id, startSlot, slotCount:positionDurationSlots(pos.id) });
      }
    }
  }

  state.rejectedSuggestions = new Set();
  renderAll();
  showToast('Schedule loaded.');
}

/* ================================================================
   INIT
   ================================================================ */
function init(){
  document.getElementById('btn-settings').addEventListener('click', ()=>openSettings('people'));
  document.getElementById('btn-close-settings').addEventListener('click', closeSettings);
  document.getElementById('settings-overlay').addEventListener('click', (e)=>{ if(e.target.id==='settings-overlay') closeSettings(); });
  document.querySelectorAll('.db-modal-tab').forEach(t=>t.addEventListener('click', ()=>{ editingRuleId = null; switchModalTab(t.dataset.tab); }));

  document.getElementById('btn-solve').addEventListener('click', solve);
  document.getElementById('btn-save').addEventListener('click', exportToExcel);
  document.getElementById('btn-load').addEventListener('click', ()=>document.getElementById('file-input').click());
  document.getElementById('file-input').addEventListener('change', (e)=>{
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    if(file) importFromExcel(file).catch(err=>{ console.error(err); alert('Could not read that file: '+err.message); });
    e.target.value = '';
  });

  ['rule-search','filter-person','filter-position','filter-time','filter-required','filter-preferred','filter-inactive'].forEach(id=>{
    const el = document.getElementById(id);
    el.addEventListener('input', renderRules);
    el.addEventListener('change', renderRules);
  });

  document.addEventListener('keydown', (e)=>{ if(e.key==='Escape') closeFloating(); });

  renderAll();
}

init();
</script>
```


### Paste in a template

I want a constraint solver that will solve scheduling problems for several people over 15 min time slots. More people or positions can be added as needed. People and positions can be defined with various attributes used for constaints (e.g. "Male" and "Female" people, "Physically demanding" positions, etc.) that can be used to define rules. The program should support rules for people, positions, and time slots in any combination (e.g. "Person A cannot be scheduled for Position B during Time Slot C") or any generalization (e.g. Person A cannot have Position B, ever). Rules can be marked as required, preferred, or inactive (ignored during checks and solving), and the program will fill in the schedule as a table-like chart with time on the x-axis (at the top) and people on the y-axis (on the left) with all the assignments required by the required rules, and faded suggestions for the preferred rules. 
The main schedule chart will be on the left, and a list of the most possibility-reducing decisions will be on the right, with the most possibility-reducing decisions at the top and any rules that are currently violated above them in the list with a red outline. Below both the main schedule chart and the list of decisions will be a list of all the rules, with the required rules at the top and the preferred rules below them. When a time slot is selected there should be a dropdown of all positions, with positions that align with preferred rules marked with a star and positions currently forbidden by required rules as grayed out, and when you hover your mouse over them the contradicting rule will be displayed as a hover window and the appropriate areas on the chart will be outlined in red. 
The rules list should have search and filter options to display only rules that 1. deal with a time constraint, person constraint, or position constraint in general as a specific constraint (e.g. "Person A cannot be scheduled for Position B" has a person and a position being specifically constrained), 2. are required or preferred, and 3. rules that deal with specific times, people, or positions. There should be a gear icon for advanced settings that opens a menu from which users can define new positions, classifying tags, and rules. When positions are defined they are assigned a length of time which must be fit into the schedule (e.g. a position that is 30 minutes long will take up two 15 minute time slots and someone can't be scheduled for it for a single time slot). An implicit built-in rule is that no person can be scheduled for more than one position at a time, but a position can be scheduled for more than one person at a time unless it is checked as a "single-person" position when it is defined. Rules can also have tags that can be used to group them together for searching and filtering. The program should have a "solve" button that will attempt to fill in the schedule as much as possible while satisfying all required rules and as many preferred rules as possible. Positions should have color-coding options in the advanced settings that will be displayed in the main schedule chart, with faded versions of the colors displayed for preferred rules' suggestions that haven't been selected yet. If a suggestion is clicked on their should be a small popup with a "accept" and "reject button" -- if accepted the suggestion will be added to the schedule and the chart will be updated, and if rejected the suggestion will be removed visually from the chart (but the preferred rule that spurred the suggestion will remain in the rules list, unaffected).
The default program should have 10:30 to 4:30 as the time range (24 time slots), but this can be changed in the advanced settings. The program should have save and load buttons that will save the current schedule as a formatted excel file and load a schedule from a formatted excel file, respectively.
